cards.subject: A smugglers' landing
lines: Ratchet "was begun by smugglers and became populated mainly by not only their foul ilk, but also all those others whom various societies had cast out."
Then a goblin contractor finished building Orgrimmar, took his fee, and put a town on top of it.

cards.subject: He built Orgrimmar and then bought this
lines: Thrall hired him as chief engineer to raise the city after the Third War, and he founded this place with the money once it was done.
The town is not a Horde outpost.
It is what a contractor did with his paycheck.

cards.subject: The only neutral ocean crossing in the game
lines: Kalimdor to the Eastern Kingdoms, and the ship belongs to the Steamwheedle Cartel, so both factions ride it.
Every other sea route in 1.12 is owned by one side or the other.
The round trip is under four minutes.

cards.subject: Nobody is sailing it
lines: The ship gets a named captain, a bosun and a parrot two years after this.
In here you cross an ocean on an empty boat.

cards.subject: There is no auction house
lines: The neutral auction houses in 1.12 are Booty Bay, Gadgetzan and Everlook. Ratchet, the fourth Steamwheedle town, has none.
Bank, inn, forge, mailbox — and that is the list.
You bring your goods to the boat, not to an auctioneer.

cards.subject: Why the Alliance are here at all
lines: The goblin serves both sides, in the middle of Horde land, and for a low-level Alliance character Ratchet plus that boat is the whole way in and out of Kalimdor.
The flight point itself only arrived in patch 1.11, the last content patch before this one.
For most of vanilla you got here by road or by sea.

cards.subject: The island off the pier is a fight club
lines: "A training place for warriors of all races and creeds" — Klannoc Macleod's, and the Affray.
Pirates only take it over in Cataclysm.
In here, level thirty warriors of both factions turn up on the same rock to be beaten up in order.

cards.subject: The neutrality is enforced, not agreed
lines: They net you for five seconds, and then they shoot.
Start something in town and you do not get to finish it.

cards.subject: The samophlange man
lines: He stands here for the Tinkers' Union, put in charge of shredder development and losing to the Venture Company.
He is also the goblin who hands Horde players the samophlange.
Nobody can pronounce it and nobody can tell you what it is.

cards.subject: He sells you the other continent
lines: The goblin on the dock runs the wharf and gives out Passage to Booty Bay at around level thirty.
It is the quest that tells a player there is somewhere else.

cards.subject: There is a bounty nailed up in town
lines: Gazlowe has a Gilnean charged with piracy and with commanding the Southsea ships, and he wants the head.
The Merchant Coast south of here is pirate ground for the whole of vanilla.
They only leave in the Shattering.

cards.subject: The wrecks are the other half of the trade
lines: "The Merchant Coast receives its name from the lucrative trade that takes place through the thrifty hands of the Ratchet goblins."
There are ships lying in the shallows just off the town.
Both halves of that sentence are visible from the same pier.
